lines.text: Jesus tells a parable about praying at all times, in which a widow asks a judge for justice.
The judge refuses for a while, but he finally gives the widow justice because she keeps threatening him.
Jesus says God will promptly carry out justice for His elect who cry out to Him day and night.
A Pharisee and a priest go up to the temple, and the Pharisee thanks God he is not like other men.
The tax collector beats his breast and asks God for mercy, and he goes home justified.
